from pathlib import Path
import json,hashlib,importlib.util
r=Path.cwd().resolve()
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("original_t02_submit",r/"scripts/pbs/submit_phase.py");phase=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec);spec.loader.exec_module(phase)
rows=[]
for folder in sorted((r/"logs/pbs").glob("t02_export_cache_test_selected05_*-*")):
 p=folder/"payload.json";s=folder/"submission.json"
 if not p.is_file() or not s.is_file():continue
 d=json.loads(p.read_text());receipt=json.loads(s.read_text())
 if d.get("dry_run") or receipt.get("returncode")!=0:continue
 assert d["budget_group"]=="T02" and d["requested_gpu_count"]==1 and d["task_id"]=="T01"
 rows.append({"name":d["name"],"job_id":receipt["stdout"].strip(),"payload":str(p.relative_to(r)),"receipt_sha256":hashlib.sha256(s.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),"host":d.get("requested_host")})
ids={v["job_id"] for v in rows};assert len(ids)==len(rows)
paths=sorted((r/"results").glob("diag_t02_cache_test_selected05_*_accounting_*.json"))+sorted((r/"results").glob("diag_t02_cache_*_pin20_accounting_*.json"))
final=phase._final_accounting(r,ids,paths=paths)
reserved=[]
for v in rows:
 v["canonical_final"]=v["job_id"] in final
 if v["canonical_final"]:v["canonical_accounting_result"]=final[v["job_id"]]["accounting_result"]
 else:reserved.append(v["job_id"])
assert set(reserved)=={"710904.hopper-m-02","710908.hopper-m-02"}
assert not any(v["name"]=="t02_export_cache_test_selected05_remaining_b05" for v in rows)
print(json.dumps({"scope":"Fixed selected05 test-cache submissions only. All successful receipts without original canonical final accounting count as occupying a slot, including unknown/queued/running states. This is a conservative upper bound, not a guessed Q/R state.","successful_receipts":rows,"reserved_job_ids":reserved,"occupied_upper_bound":len(reserved),"authorized_smallx_slots":3,"next_batch":"b05"},sort_keys=True))
